scores.rationale: The candidate implements the core Ajv validation and WeakMap caching in `ToolRegistry`, but introduces several flaws and test gaps compared to the ticket and reference. In `registry.ts`, it uses a default import `import Ajv from 'ajv'` with `{strict: false}` instead of named `{Ajv}` with `{allErrors: true}`, and omits logging a warning with the failing property paths on validation failure. It misses the acceptance criterion testing a function-valued tool definition whose returned schema differs between calls (testing mutation of the same schema reference instead), and its `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` test stubs the registry and skips the corrected retry round. Finally, it leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and makes unrelated edits to `src/providers/providerFactory.test.ts`, `adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md`, and other spec files.
